title: ZIP Codes in 4D v11 SQL
author: Luis Piñeiros, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Bundled ZIP Code lookup table (80,000+ US ZIP codes)
SOAP web service call to www.webservicex.net ZIP code service

historical_commentary.text: This note demonstrates two era-appropriate approaches to ZIP-code lookup: a bundled static database table, and a free public SOAP web service. The bundled-table approach is timeless in concept but the specific 80,000-row dataset from 2009 is now hopelessly outdated for real US ZIP/city/state mappings and would need to be replaced with a current data source. The SOAP web service dependency on webservicex.net is very likely defunct or unreliable today, since that free-tier SOAP ecosystem from the late 2000s has largely disappeared in favor of modern REST/JSON APIs (e.g. Zippopotam.us, USPS APIs, or paid geocoding services), so that portion of the note is effectively obsolete as written.
related_updates: Modern REST-based ZIP/postal code and geocoding APIs (e.g. USPS Web Tools, Zippopotam.us, Google Maps Geocoding API) replace the free SOAP service referenced here
4D's native REST request commands (introduced v16+) would be the modern way to call any such external lookup service instead of the legacy CALL WEB SERVICE/SOAP approach
